name: com.ireshsampath.unity-assets.easy-video
description: EasyVideo is a modular Unity package that simplifies video playback workflows. It provides an easy-to-use system for idle and action videos, smooth transitions, looping control, runtime video switching, and flexible resolution & fit handling using Unity VideoPlayer.

samples.description: Example scene demonstrating idle/action video playback, transitions, looping behavior, resolution & fit modes, and runtime video switching by index or ID.
